confidenceLevels.tentative: Plausible and fits observations, but unverified. Do not depend on it.
confidenceLevels.unknown: Not established. Listed so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

notes.overlayWarning: gMapStateManager and gActionSt live in overlay ov000's BSS and are only mapped while ov000 is loaded. Reading them outside a loaded map returns 0x00000000, which means 'no map loaded' — not a bad address.
notes.decompHeaderWarning: Three field types in the fe11-us headers are wrong (see docs/reverse-engineering/fe11.md). Treat decompilation field types as hints to test, never as facts to copy.
notes.evidencePolicy: A decompiler's suggestion is not evidence. A live read that matches a predicted value is.

movementRange.reason: The game's own blue overlay (MapStateManager.unk_d30 and the four neighbouring 0x80 buffers) is NOT resident: all five were sampled across 1500 frames and none ever held a range-like value. The overlay exists only during a live move preview. A reader must compute range from the game's own data rather than expect the overlay, because depending on the overlay means depending on screen mode.

unknowns.detail: Not located in RAM or in the ROM. RAM holds message-table IDs (gop_001, MTUTH_00, MG_MACEDONIA, ill_203) but no prose. A plain ASCII scan of the ROM found none either — only leftover Nintendo Wi-Fi/SSL strings. The string MTUTH does not appear in the ROM at all despite RAM pointing at MTUTH_*, so the table is likely built at runtime or the text is compressed/encoded.
